immutability.rule: Do not edit either preregistration file after any CMTE-A2 DS7/DS8 residual, nonconformity, p-value, epoch score, alarm, or result is exposed. Corrections require a new, explicitly superseding preregistration before any further holdout access.

confirmatory.reason: The TEXBAT corpus, repository metadata, and historical evaluator/artifacts were previously exposed.
forbidden_uses: feature, residual, covariance, nonconformity, p-value, or score changes
timing, phase, metric, bootstrap, or success-criterion changes
choosing a DS8 fallback based on observed performance

known_exposure: DS7/DS8 corpus names, official attack descriptions, phase boundaries, raw-file metadata, and recording lengths
repository and external-storage manifests and prepared-input metadata
historical Method-A/node and historical B0/evaluator artifacts in the broader project
DS1-DS4 CMTE development results and prior selection of A2 with q99.5
prior_exposure_disclosure.not_exposed_before_this_preregistration: No CMTE-A2 DS7/DS8 model inference, signed residual, Q score, conformal p-value, epoch score, alarm, or confirmatory metric has been generated.
prior_exposure_disclosure.interpretation: Results may support a prespecified CMTE-A2-specific holdout claim, not a claim that DS7/DS8 were pristine to the project or investigators.

raw_iq.coverage_note: The byte-derived coverage is authoritative for available data even though the PDF describes a longer scenario.

DS8.bit_estimation_interpretation: The approximately 50 microsecond bit-estimation effect is not a separate timing/onset claim at one-second analysis windows.

primary_prepared_input.preparation_policy: deterministic source-only preparation before any CMTE-A2 model access; freeze generated NPZ, manifest, rendered configuration, and wrapper hashes before confirmatory evaluation
primary_prepared_input.on_preparation_failure: Primary DS8 result is NA with an explicit reason. Historical Method-A node data may be reported only as sensitivity and may never silently replace the primary input.

new_cmte_a2_wrapper.requirement: The wrapper and all implementation/code hashes must be frozen in a separate pre-evaluation commit before DS7/DS8 confirmatory evaluation.

sources.DS4_caveat: No complex NPZ exists. Existing node input is an explicit mixed-producer development sensitivity source only and cannot support a confirmatory claim.

input.signal: raw receiver tap magnitude followed by prompt-relative normalization and prefix-fitted feature scaling

head: Linear(128,128)
GELU
Linear(128,9)
architecture.prediction: use the final causal GRU timestep to predict the next 9-vector

training.holdout_use: model selection only; no gradient or scaler fitting
training.scaler: feature-wise nanmean and population nanstd (ddof=0) on prefix gradient-training PRNs only; non-finite mean -> 0; non-finite or <1e-6 std -> 1; standardized non-finite -> 0
training.selection: strict minimum held-PRN prefix validation MSE; ties retain the earlier checkpoint

residual.distribution_fit_source: eligible cleanStatic prefix residuals in [0,240), excluding held-PRN model-selection rows

distribution.n: number of eligible residual vectors in the distribution-fit role

threshold.quantile_equation: sort scores ascending as z[0..n-1]; q_higher(p) = z[ceil(p*(n-1))]

diagnostics.empirical_target1: smallest observed threshold-role score tau such that mean(score > tau) <= 0.01; ties use the higher tau

B0_Exact.label: chronological B0 with exact gate semantics
B0_Exact.checkpoint: same newly trained prefix-only chronological shared PRN-local GRU

per_epoch.K: count of current PRNs with node_score > node_threshold
per_epoch.tail: P[X >= K] for X ~ Binomial(N,p), computed by the exact finite sum

B0_Exact.reset: physical recording/run reset; no cross-recording carry
B0_Exact.recalibration: normal-only chronological recalibration; do not reuse the historical threshold tied to the old checkpoint
B0_Exact.historical_numerical_equivalence: A separate gate-only test must compare exact K/N, tails, max surprise, EWMA, and alarms against the historical evaluator/golden using historical precomputed node inputs. It does not assert new chronological checkpoint score equivalence.

B0_Enhanced.label: B0-Enhanced
B0_Enhanced.checkpoint: same newly trained prefix-only chronological shared PRN-local GRU
B0_Enhanced.binomial_p: empirical strict exceedance probabilities in the same normal threshold role
B0_Enhanced.causal_smoothing: pandas-style ewm(alpha=0.75, adjust=false): current weight 0.75, previous weight 0.25, initialized at the first raw value
B0_Enhanced.relationship: Separate comparator matching previous CMTE A1 semantics; never label as B0-Exact.

common.matched_clean_fpr_diagnostic: Using [300,330) only, choose for each comparator the observed threshold-role score with strict-exceedance occupancy nearest to CMTE-A2's threshold-role occupancy (absolute difference; tie -> higher threshold), freeze it, then evaluate on clean test and DS7/DS8. Diagnostic only; it cannot replace primary thresholds or success decisions.

timing.boundary_policy: A window belongs to an interval only when fully contained in it. Windows crossing 90, 110, 130, or 150 seconds are excluded from both adjacent phase metrics.
timing.ds8_50us_policy: No onset, delay, or phase claim is made at 50 microseconds because primary windows are one second.

metrics.clean_fpr: mean alarm occupancy over eligible independent clean-test epochs
metrics.stable_pre_fpr: mean alarm occupancy over eligible [30,90) epochs
metrics.post_detection_rate: mean alarm occupancy over eligible epochs fully contained in [110,recording end)
metrics.persistent_detection_rate: mean alarm occupancy over eligible epochs fully contained in [150,recording end)
metrics.first_alarm_delay_s: minimum window_end_s-110 among alarmed eligible post-onset epochs; NA/censored if none
metrics.persistent_3_epoch_delay_s: delay of the first epoch in the first run of three alarmed, same-recording, 0.5-second-contiguous eligible post-onset epochs; NA/censored if none
metrics.roc_auc: epoch-score ROC-AUC using stable-pre [30,90) as negative and post-onset [110,end) as positive; transition and boundary-crossing windows excluded

prn_count_diagnostic.claim_policy: diagnostic only; sparse N strata are reported as NA rather than pooled or used to change aggregation

bootstrap.construction: Within each scenario, physical recording, phase, segment/channel-derived gap-safe epoch chunk, form non-overlapping 20-epoch blocks anchored at the chunk/phase start. Resample whole blocks with replacement within each statistic's required phase stratum to its original complete-block count. Never cross a phase, recording, or cadence gap.
bootstrap.point_estimates: use all eligible epochs; complete blocks govern confidence intervals only
bootstrap.minimum_for_ci: at least two complete 20-epoch blocks in every phase/class required by the statistic
bootstrap.insufficient_policy: CI is NA with a machine-readable reason naming the insufficient contiguous phase/class

success_criteria.decision_rule: All criteria 1-6 must pass; NA in a required primary DS result fails the overall success decision but remains an honest NA result.

criteria.name: per_scenario_stable_pre
criteria.pass: DS7 CMTE-A2 stable_pre_fpr <= 0.05 and DS8 CMTE-A2 stable_pre_fpr <= 0.05

criteria.name: catastrophic_pre_alarm_guard
criteria.pass: Neither DS7 nor DS8 CMTE-A2 stable_pre_fpr is >= 0.20
criteria.note: This explicit catastrophic guard is retained even though criterion 2 is stricter.

criteria.name: improvement_over_b0_exact
criteria.pass: At least one of DS7/DS8 improves chronological B0 with exact gate semantics at similar independent clean FPR (absolute difference <=0.005) by either first_alarm_delay_s at least 0.5 s faster, persistent_3_epoch_delay_s at least 0.5 s faster, post_detection_rate higher, or persistent_detection_rate higher. Rate comparisons are strict (> with numerical tolerance 1e-12). A pre-onset-alarming detector cannot claim a delay advantage on that scenario.

criteria.name: no_catastrophic_degradation_on_other_scenario
criteria.pass: On the other scenario, CMTE-A2 is not simultaneously worse than B0-Exact in every available attack metric: first-alarm delay, persistent-3-epoch delay, post-detection rate, and persistent-detection rate. A missing CMTE-A2 detection when B0-Exact detects is worse; both censored is a tie. Stable-pre and clean guards in criteria 1-3 still apply.

criteria.name: prn_count_diagnostic_complete
criteria.pass: The preregistered PRN-count diagnostic is produced for clean test, DS7, and DS8, including explicit NA reasons for sparse strata, with no aggregation change based on N.

forbidden_methods: mean e or any e-value aggregation
any sequential detector score or sequential threshold
online normalization, adaptive scaler, adaptive covariance, or adaptive threshold
PRN identity input or learned PRN embedding
DS7/DS8-driven model, threshold, aggregation, timing, metric, or code selection
reuse of the historical B0 threshold with the new chronological checkpoint
silent substitution of historical Method-A node input for failed DS8 primary preparation
bridging role, split, recording, segment, channel, or cadence gaps
required_audit_outputs_after_future_eval: implementation/freeze commit SHA and code hashes
all source, prepared-input, wrapper, checkpoint, scaler, state, calibration, and threshold hashes
primary and diagnostic operating points kept separate
point estimates, bootstrap CIs or explicit NA reasons
statement that the preregistration files were not edited after result exposure
